picks.headline: NVIDIA Introduces Native Rust Support for Writing CUDA GPU Kernels
picks.why: Provides a memory-safe GPU programming option directly within the CUDA ecosystem alongside C++ and Python.
picks.title: Introducing CUDA Rust: Two Tracks for Writing GPU Kernels

picks.headline: DeepMind Releases AlphaGenome Atlas Mapping 9 Billion Human DNA Variants
picks.why: Provides a predictive map detailing the molecular impact of every single-letter mutation across the human genome.
picks.title: AlphaGenome Atlas: A predictive map of every possible DNA letter change in the human genome

picks.headline: OpenAI Publishes AI-Generated Formal Proof for Navier-Stokes Millennium Problem
picks.why: Claims a complete solution and Lean-verified formal proof produced by an unreleased model using 130 billion tokens.
picks.title: On the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem

picks.headline: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Images 2.5 with New Dedicated API Models
picks.why: Delivers improved multi-turn instruction following, faster inference times, and better subject preservation from reference images.
picks.title: Introducing ChatGPT Images 2.5

picks.headline: Audit Finds AI Coding Assistants Ignore Software Supply-Chain Trust Signals
picks.why: Testing across 1,920 trials revealed AI coding assistants never verify package signatures, provenance, or SBOMs before installation.
picks.title: Do AI Coding Assistants Check Before They Install? A Pre-Registered Demand-Side Audit of Trust Signals in the Research Software Supply Chain

picks.headline: HoneyRoute Reroutes Adversarial Requests to Honeypots, Slashing Token Costs 98%
picks.why: Introduces a streaming inference layer that detects malicious LLM prompts and diverts them to dedicated honeypot models.
picks.title: HoneyRoute: Honeypot-Model Routing for Adversarial LLM Serving

picks.headline: AWS Benchmarks Blackwell-Based G7 Instances for MoE Model Inference
picks.why: Demonstrates improved throughput, lower latency, and reduced cost-per-token for 30B MoE models compared to G5 and G6 instances.
picks.title: Benchmarking small LLM inference on SageMaker AI: G7 vs G5 and G6

papers.headline: Training-Free Task Vectors Enable Weight-Space Edits via Forward Passes
papers.why: Converts activation steering vectors directly into rank-one model weight edits using forward-pass statistics without fine-tuning.
papers.title: Training-Free Task Vectors for LLM Behavioral Control

papers.headline: BeaconKV Compresses KV Caches During Extended Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
papers.why: Uses query clustering to predict and retain essential context tokens, significantly reducing memory overhead during long reasoning chains.
papers.title: BeaconKV: Key-Value Cache Compression Guided by Beacon Queries for Efficient Large Reasoning Model Inference

papers.headline: Multi-Turn Evaluation Benchmark Reveals Underreported Sycophancy and Model Collapse
papers.why: Tests model resilience over 25 conversational turns to prove that standard short-horizon evaluations fail to capture sycophantic degradation.
papers.title: Measuring LLM Sycophancy under Sustained Multi-Turn Pressure
